children: On-chain analyst Ai Yi said XXAntiWar has continued shorting ZEC. According to Odaily, address 0xfe5…5d850 opened two ZEC short positions near $1,273 and $1,181 and has made a combined profit of about $693,000, while address 0x0c4…5d516 opened a $3.56 million ZEC short near $1,129 and is up about $34,000.
At 5 a.m. today, address 0x9bb…9bbf2 opened a new 3x leveraged ZEC short worth about $4.5 million at around $1,120.8. The position is currently showing an unrealized loss of about $23,000.

title: XXAntiWar Continues Shorting ZEC, With Two Wallets Posting Combined Gains of About $693,000
